code: import axios from"axios";const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL||"http://127.0.0.1:8000";export const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE_URL,timeout:30000});const memoryCache=new Map();function buildCacheKey(path,params){return"".concat(path,":").concat(JSON.stringify(params||{}));}async function getCached(path,params){let ttlMs=arguments.length>2&&arguments[2]!==undefined?arguments[2]:5*60*1000;const key=buildCacheKey(path,params);const now=Date.now();const cached=memoryCache.get(key);if(cached&&now-cached.ts<=ttlMs){return cached.value;}const{data}=await api.get(path,{params});memoryCache.set(key,{ts:now,value:data});return data;}export async function fetchIntersections(){const{data}=await api.get("/api/intersections");return data;}export async function fetchPublicConfig(){return getCached("/api/config/public",undefined,30*60*1000);}export async function fetchTraffic(params){const{data}=await api.get("/api/traffic",{params});return data;}export async function fetchAnalysis(params){const{data}=await api.get("/api/analysis",{params});return data;}export async function fetchDataRange(){return getCached("/api/data-range",undefined,30*60*1000);}export async function fetchDirectionRoutes(){return getCached("/api/direction-routes",undefined,30*60*1000);}export async function fetchWeather(params){const{data}=await api.get("/api/weather",{params});return data;}export async function fetchPrediction(params){const{data}=await api.get("/api/prediction",{params});return data;}export async function fetchPredictionMeta(){return getCached("/api/prediction/meta",undefined,30*60*1000);}export async function fetchPredictionOptions(){return getCached("/api/prediction/options",undefined,30*60*1000);}export async function fetchPredictionCompare(params){const{data}=await api.get("/api/prediction/compare",{params});return data;}
